stories.title: En Bosnie, Milorad Dodik annonce la victoire de son parti lors des élections générales

en.title: In Bosnia, Milorad Dodik announces his party's victory in general elections
en.summary: Milorad Dodik's party retained power in Bosnia's general elections held Sunday, securing its position in the collective presidency and parliament of Republika Srpska. Voter turnout was notably low in the election.

stories.title: Nations League: Liga A – Zwei Traumtore in Porto – keine Tore in Thessaloniki

en.title: Nations League: League A – Two spectacular goals in Porto – no goals in Thessaloniki
en.summary: Portugal defeated Norway 2-1, securing early qualification for the quarterfinals. Germany and Greece drew 0-0 in their match.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Jemen plant Grossoffensive gegen Huthi-Rebellen

en.title: War in Middle East – Yemen plans major offensive against Houthi rebels
en.summary: Yemen's president announced plans for a military offensive against Houthi rebels in the Middle East conflict.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Merz an Putin: «Hören Sie diesen sinnlosen Krieg auf!»

en.title: War in Ukraine – Merz to Putin: "Stop This Senseless War!"
en.summary: During the German Chancellor's visit to Ukraine, air raid sirens sounded multiple times as he called for an end to the conflict.

stories.title: Nations League: Deutschland spielt in Griechenland nur unentschieden

en.title: Nations League: Germany plays to a draw in Greece
en.summary: Germany and Greece finished their Nations League match 0-0 in Thessaloniki, similar to Germany's earlier 0-1 loss in Augsburg.

stories.title: Dans les rangs de l'UDC, Marcel Dettling et Sylvain Freymond renoncent à la succession de Guy Parmelin au Conseil fédéral

en.title: Within the UDC ranks, Marcel Dettling and Sylvain Freymond renounce pursuing Guy Parmelin's succession on the Federal Council
en.summary: Marcel Dettling, UDC party president, and Sylvain Freymond, national councillor and president of UDC Vaud, have decided not to pursue the Federal Council seat vacated by Guy Parmelin. Freymond intends to focus on cantonal elections scheduled for 2027.

stories.title: Regierungswahlen Kanton Zug – Alle Bisherigen wiedergewählt – Laura Dittli mit bestem Resultat

en.title: Zug Government Elections – All Incumbents Re-elected – Laura Dittli with Best Result
en.summary: All members of the Zug cantonal government retained their seats in elections, with no surprises. The left-green alliance again failed to gain representation.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN SCHWEIZ - Zuger Regierungswahlen: Alle bisherigen Mitglieder sind wiedergewählt +++ Schweizer Politiker wollen Musks Investitionspläne im Wallis verhindern

en.title: Switzerland Announcements - Zug Government Elections: All Incumbents Re-elected +++ Swiss Politicians Want to Block Musk's Investment Plans in Valais
en.summary: All current members of the Zug cantonal government were re-elected. Swiss politicians are seeking to prevent implementation of Elon Musk's investment plans in the Valais region.

stories.title: Papables évoqués à la succession de Guy Parmelin, Marcel Dettling et Sylvain Freymond renoncent

en.title: Potential successors to Guy Parmelin, Marcel Dettling and Sylvain Freymond withdraw
en.summary: UDC president Marcel Dettling and national councillor Sylvain Freymond have withdrawn from contention for Guy Parmelin's Federal Council seat. Freymond prefers to focus on cantonal elections in 2027.

stories.title: Face à la contestation des lycéens, les cours seront suspendus «totalement ou partiellement» lundi dans 400 à 500 établissements français

en.title: Faced with high school student protests, classes will be suspended "totally or partially" Monday in 400 to 500 French schools
en.summary: France's Education Minister announced that classes will be suspended fully or partially Monday in 400 to 500 secondary schools where safety conditions are not met. Twenty-four school buildings have been burned or damaged during the student protests.

stories.title: En France, 24 lycées "saccagés ou incendiés" et des cours toujours suspendus lundi

en.title: In France, 24 secondary schools "vandalized or burned" and classes still suspended Monday
en.summary: The French Education Minister reported that 24 school buildings have been burned or vandalized during secondary school protests. Classes will be fully or partially suspended Monday in 400 to 500 secondary schools.

stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Russischer Angriff auf Kiew während Besuch von Friedrich Merz

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Russian attack on Kyiv during Friedrich Merz's visit
en.summary: Russia has been waging war against Ukraine for over four years. The ticker covers major developments in the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: Warum Linth, Swisscom oder Swatch in diesem neuen Schweizer Aktienfonds nichts verloren haben

en.title: Why Linth, Swisscom or Swatch have no place in this new Swiss stock fund
en.summary: A newly launched investment product focuses exclusively on strict Swiss criteria, which unexpectedly excludes some of Switzerland's most prominent domestic companies.

stories.title: Altlasten und kein Ende: Der neue Bär-Chef muss sich gedulden mit dem Neustart

en.title: Legacy issues and no end: The new Bear CEO must be patient with the restart
en.summary: The conclusion of a sanctions investigation against Julius Bär reveals new misconduct issues. Regulators released the private bank only under conditions, though CEO Stefan Bollinger has reasons for optimism.

stories.title: HSG, Militär, Schnupftabak: Peter Spuhler will in Asien und Amerika wachsen – setzt in seinen Firmen aber voll auf Schweizer

en.title: HSG, Military, Snuff: Peter Spuhler wants to grow in Asia and America – but relies entirely on Swiss in his companies
en.summary: Stadler Rail and Rieter appointed new Swiss CEOs who studied in St. Gallen, reflecting a pattern where most executives in the group studied there. Experts consider this lack of diversity risky.

stories.title: Rausgeschmissenes Steuergeld? In der Telekombranche gibt es erhebliche Zweifel, ob Subventionen einen schnelleren Ausbau von Breitbandinternet bewirken

en.title: Wasted Tax Money? The Telecom Industry Has Serious Doubts Whether Subsidies Accelerate Broadband Internet Expansion
en.summary: A commissioned study questions whether 730 million francs in federal broadband subsidies will achieve their intended goal, suggesting they may produce the opposite effect.

stories.title: Lindt & Sprüngli in der Krise: Macht es Ernst Tanner wie der Markenbotschafter Roger Federer – oder doch wie Simon Ammann?

en.title: Lindt & Sprüngli in Crisis: Will Ernst Tanner Follow Ambassador Roger Federer's Example – or Simon Ammann's?
en.summary: The 80-year-old chocolate company leader had an opportunity to retire at the peak but remained in position, contributing to Lindt & Sprüngli's current difficulties.
